title.narrative: Chronic - Drought and Food Insecurity in Kayes, Mali

description.narrative: Impact of chronic drought on decrease in food productivity, loss of livelihoods, deforestation, soil erosion and depletion of water sources.

This project has been designed build on the achievements and lessons learnt of the Climate Smart Livelihoods (CSL) project that recently finished in Kayes Region. The capacities created by this project at Branch level will be instrumental for the implementation of this action as well as networks and relations established at community level and with external partners and line authorities. Most urgent needs are first of all related to the decrease in food production that has resulted in significantly low access to food in the area which requires emergency food assistance, so farmers and rural people can survive and function normally at least this year despites these overall losses.

This project proposes to study different response options with cash based programming or food in-kind distributions, depending on the results from market assessment to be done during project implementation. To tackle mortality & morbidity associated to malnutrition and diseases in children under 5, this project proposes to combine the increase of access to food with increased access to water at community level by rehabilitating water points and setting up water management structures.
